title: calathea dubia
intro: Calathea dubia, commonly known as the 'Jungle Cat,' is a species of plant belonging to the Marantaceae family. This low-maintenance, air-purifying plant is valued for its ability to remove pollutants and toxins from the air, contributing to improved indoor air quality and overall health benefits. Studies suggest that Calathea dubia may exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and enhancing sleep quality due to its calming and soothing properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
